prompts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup / precise-object-edit. Create a realistic, production-quality decorative visual refinement of the EXACT Ascend Studio desktop workspace in reference image 1. Target 1280 x 720, matching its aspect ratio. Current date 2026-10-09; do not add dates.
REFERENCE ROLES: Image 1 is authoritative for all layout, content, typography, density, and UI component anatomy. Image 2 is authoritative for the COLOR AND MATERIAL ART DIRECTION ONLY: luminous pastel gradients, bright translucent glass, blue/cyan, lavender, rosy pink, coral/apricot, buttery yellow and fresh mint/lime accents. Borrow this vibrant yet pale multi-color refracted quality, NOT its landing-page layout, French text, cards, shopping bag or spherical objects.
Preserve three columns and all existing content: left compact project/task groups, middle conversation, right free canvas with movable code and evidence objects. Keep new task, automation tasks and capability library. Preserve project names, task rows, spacing, neutral gray selected row and compact readable Chinese typography. AI text directly on page background, no AI bubbles, no chat avatars; user bubble right aligned. Ascend Studio branding. No learning center or learning group. No new features, panels, tabs, charts or widgets.
Keep UI surfaces warm white/light gray and text charcoal with restrained cool-blue-violet controls. BUT the decorative artwork must be clearly colorful, lighter and more chromatic than gray/monochrome computing motifs. High luminosity with locally richer pastel color saturation: cyan #80d4f2, periwinkle #a59cef, pink #efa7cd, coral #f6b4a1, yellow #ffdc97, mint #b7e7c6. Smooth multi-hue gradients inside translucent sculptural abstract shapes, milky clear highlights, subtle refraction, soft daylight and controlled diffuse shadows. Color confined to illustration and surrounding light; no saturated selection or text outline. Avoid muddy gray metallic finish, desaturated lavender-only artwork, neon and dark colors.
PRIMARY CHANGE: decorative imagery should be ABSTRACT and artistic rather than literal representations of computable objects or operable widgets. Give several connected decorative accents: a modest artwork in task-canvas header whitespace, a smaller related vignette in sidebar footer, and a faint softly faded fragment in blank canvas margin. Approximately 8-12% art coverage. Keep text and controls clear, original hierarchy and task density intact. No hard framed object that could be mistaken for a button/card or a canvas object. No functional marks or labels inside artwork.
Avoid pearls, balls, spheres, jewelry, gemstones, mascots, literal chips, motherboards, server boxes, tensor grids, matrix cell markings, operator nodes, graph edges, coordinate ticks, profiling bars, GPU/NPU labels, numbers and technical legend. No new grid-based decoration; preserve the existing subtle canvas dot background. No device frame, browser chrome, option number or concept title printed on image.
Direction: Refracted light ribbon.
Create a fluid sculptural ribbon of very thin translucent gel/glass, gently turning and opening into 3 or 4 soft parallel folds. It is an abstract luminous contour, never a rectangular wafer or recognizable object. Cyan and blue run through one fold, rose/coral through another, mint and pale yellow through the underside, lavender where colors overlap. Matte-soft transmitted light, precise thin edge glints and delicate colored caustics blending into the white UI. A small related curved stroke appears by the sidebar footer; a very pale flowing fragment hugs only the blank canvas edge. Main art remains modest, beautifully crafted, airy and chromatically rich.

Direction: Abstract translucent membrane folds.
Create 3-5 organically shaped ULTRA-THIN translucent films, irregularly folded and loosely fanned into a small asymmetrical sculpture. Soft corners, rounded undulating contours, no precise rectangular card, no gridded surfaces. Each membrane blends between vivid pastel cyan, pink, apricot, lilac and a small hint of pale lime; colors interact through optical overlap. The emphasis is delicately glowing material thickness, clear refraction, fine edges and soft daylight. It feels like abstract color passing through layered space, NOT stackable objects or a real computational instrument. Main art stays in the task canvas header's blank area. Make a subtle larger cropped film at the empty right canvas margin, and a miniature folded-film echo in the sidebar footer. Preserve the screenshot UI completely, including the topbar breadcrumb text.

Direction: Colorful rippling refracted light field.
Create an ABSTRACT light-field artwork using gently layered rippling translucent surfaces and elongated freeform caustic contours, partly fading into the white background. No recognizable freestanding object, no spheres, no solid cubes, no rigid frames. Rich pastel cyan/azure flows into soft lilac and rose, a sunny pale apricot/yellow area adds warmth, and a small mint shimmer keeps the palette fresh. It should feel like looking through thin optical film with soft prismatic daylight, a beautiful editorial texture with enough crisp micro-ripples to avoid an indistinct blurry gradient blob. Make this direction flatter and more atmospheric than a folded ribbon or sculptural membrane. Distribute a small swatch of the light-field in task-canvas header whitespace, a distinct quiet rippled accent at sidebar bottom, and a lightly faded abstract pool at empty outer canvas margin. Preserve all topbar and conversation content; no colored wash behind body text.
